title: The shot: A0 to A5, your R-7 and P-12 in the shoot house through the suit, drawn and played by the game's code
about: Your words of 2026-11-15: "Sound design is pretty weak, guns should bang harder and closer to realistic". v0.0.17's shot peaked high but its loudest 50 ms, what the ear hears as loudness, sat at -15.6 dBFS: a click with a tail. Each view draws one candidate's first 300 ms (your R-7 through the combat EVA suit's hearing filter, the room's answer and the game's master; your P-12 under it), the loudest 10 ms and 50 ms shaded with their levels. Open a view live (O) to hear it: Space or a click the R-7, P the P-12, B a burst of five. In play, the Esc menu's To score page switches the shot live in the house (and &shot=A0..A5 anywhere). You starred A4 on 2026-11-19 and asked for the R-7's wave on the P-12 and the R-7 "meaner, blunter, more bass heavy. less a \"PAF\" and more a \"DOOM\"": that is A5, every scene's from v0.0.24, in group D beside A4.

groups.about: A5 is A4 with the P-12 firing A4's R-7 wave (its own crack, action and loudness, about 3.8 dB under the rifle) and the R-7 rebuilt: a blunter blast (its positive phase 1.9 ms, A4's 1.1), darker gas, a lower, longer and louder gust and chest thump (85 Hz falling to 36 over 120 ms), a harder saturation, and the suit's electronics passing the rifle's boom down to 70 Hz (A4's 160). In the house through the suit: 73% of the R-7's first 200 ms under 200 Hz (A4's 17%), the loudest 50 ms -8.8 dBFS (A4's -10.6), the peak -1.3. Open a view live (O) and press Space for the R-7, P for the P-12, B for a burst.
